worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.summary: Throw a pinch of toxic dust to a chosen point; it bursts at once, poisoning every enemy in the burst, and leaves nothing behind. It is the cheapest and shortest-cooldown of the four status casts, for tagging whatever is on top of you. Grass types pass through powder, Poison and Steel types through poison.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.descripti: The puff is thrown to a point within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick and covers a %3$s block radius on landing.
Non-friendly bodies caught are poisoned for %1$s, losing health over time.
The burst scatters %1$s motes of dust, which also sets how dense it reads.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.cling.on: Clinging: radius x0.8 and poison x1.3, but cooldown x1.1 - to poison one hard target for longer.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.cling.off: Wide scatter: radius x1.15 and cooldown x0.9, poison x0.8 - to tag a small knot at once.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.timing: Thrown to a point: range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.growth.0: From level %1$s the burst scatters %2$s motes.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst scatters %2$s motes and the poison lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.use.0: Tag whatever is on top of you with poison
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.use.1: Poison a small knot in one burst
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.use.2: Press again and again on the shortest cooldown
worldcombat.skill.poisonpowder.preferenc: On: burst radius x0.8 and poison x1.3, but cooldown x1.1, to poison one hard target for longer. Off: wider scatter (radius x1.15), cooldown x0.9 and poison x0.8, to tag a small knot in one burst.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of throwing. Larger values chase harder and drop the puff out of reach more often.
Only throws when at least this many non-friendly bodies stand within 2.5 blocks of the target; 1 means cast whenever the target is there.
When on, the companion may leave its post to scatter powder; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
